primary_research_question: How effectively can leakage-safe spatio-temporal machine-learning models forecast next-year aggregate crime counts across heterogeneous Indian police reporting units under incomplete historical data?

secondary_research_questions.RQ1: Does temporal history provide the strongest predictive signal?
secondary_research_questions.RQ2: Do population features improve forecasting accuracy?
secondary_research_questions.RQ3: Do spatial features improve forecasting accuracy?
secondary_research_questions.RQ4: Can deep temporal models (MLP, LSTM, GRU) outperform strong classical baselines (Persistence, Ridge, Random Forest, XGBoost)?
secondary_research_questions.RQ5: How stable are model results across chronological backtest folds?
secondary_research_questions.RQ6: How does controlled synthetic gap filling affect model performance?
